ov: A small fox of the African savanna named for its huge ears, which help it keep cool and hear its prey. It is the only canid that lives mainly on insects, above all harvester termites, which also give it the water it needs.
rg: Two separate populations: East Africa from Sudan and Ethiopia to Tanzania, and southern Africa from Angola to South Africa.
fx: It has more teeth than any other non-marsupial land mammal.
It does not drink from open water; its termite prey keeps it hydrated.
